experiment: Causal annual market-state diagnostics for newly mature head-training members
state_definition: Four coarse observable groups, not learned or validated hidden regimes. Trend sign uses inherited trend60 =60bar close log change / (population sd of60daily log returns floored1e-8 * sqrt60). Negative if trend60<0; exactzero nonnegative. Volatility20 is inherited population sd of20daily log returns; low if <=annual mature rolling5 training median(linear .5 quantile), high otherwise. Annual calibration only; reset at priorDec31, same boundaries for every quarter, method and seed. No choice of state count, sign cutoff, quantile or features from subgroup outcomes. This is a new4cell diagnostic using existing descriptors, not the old R17sixcell partition or R29state90 update trigger.
descriptor_provenance: First4 reuse R18 causal market formulas from R17; order60 reuses R23/R35 excess adjacent sign-product over trailing60close returns minus permutation expectation. All use data through observation anchor, never future bars. Annual calibration rows exactly inherited rolling5 members with joint_completed<=annual cutoff; anchors can have125bar context before rolling lower bound. Threshold-fitting interface receives descriptors and annual row indices only, no outcome values.
membership: Reuse R35 A annual, Q full rolling sets at all23cutoffs; summarize annual A, added Q minus A, removed A minus Q, retained A intersect Q, both Q. All member labels mature by corresponding cutoff. Added/removed empty atDecember retained as n0, undefined rates explicit. Memberships cumulative relative to annual and overlap across quarters/roles; never pool them as independent daily observations. Main cross-year table takes latest available quarter in each year, one snapshot peryear, while allcutoffs remain available. Forecast summaries use272uniqueweeks, not pooled repeated training memberships.
coverage: Market descriptor5: annual raw1/99linear quantile bounds, raw annual population mean/sd floor1e-6; measure strict outside-bound coordinate fraction, any-coordinate outside and mean squared raw standardized coordinate distance. Reuse immutable annual neural rep25 clippingbounds and clipped-training mean/sd from R28 pipeline; evaluate raw decoded features from18 R32banks before clipping. Report perseed diagnostics and equal mean of perseed row diagnostics, not three independent observations. Coverage is descriptive range screening, not multivariate density/OOD probability or feature importance. Different5/25dim any-outside rates not directly comparable; no covariate thresholds are changed in prediction models.

support.meaning: Descriptive sample-size flags only, not independent effective sample size, statistical significance, or official model qualification. Daily labels overlap; temporal dependence remains. All sparse/empty cells reported without merging, smoothing, imputation or inferred reliable rates.

label_decomposition: For each cutoff and target role added/removed/both versus annual, report state shares and conditional up-rate differences. Decompose overall target-minus-annual up-rate: composition=sum_k((wT-wA)*rA), within_state=sum_k(wT*(rT-rA)). Target-empty cells contribute0 via zero target weight; do not impute a target conditional rate. If target has observations in a state absent from annual, components are undefined with explicit support reason. Empty target => all undefined. This fixes annual rates for composition, so accounting path-dependent and not causal; component sum must equal overallrate difference. Report cells with support flags.
prediction_diagnostics: Reuse R35 four-arm actual probabilities/seed means and operation effects for all4learnedmethods. Assign each forecast its state using own signal anchor and preceding annual threshold. Group archived accuracy,Brier,logloss,AUROC,balancedaccuracy by4states for all6years,147/125periods and272pooledperiod; include perseed results, sparse/empty cells. Link each forecast only to annual/added state counts/rates available at preceding headcutoff. Forecast-state grouping describes where global addition/removal effects appear; it does NOT identify which training-state subset caused them. No per-state ablation, weights, new predictions or fit.
sequencing: Freeze allsources/protocol/inputs/5250oldfiles. Contract independently checks raw descriptors, memberships, route and synthetic state/coverage/decomposition boundaries. Then calibrate6annualstate thresholds and compute label-free assignments/coverage; freeze before any new outcome-conditioned summaries. Diagnose labels and archived predictions once with fixed definitions. Independent scalar quantiles/descriptors/coverage, future perturbations, sparse metrics and all state joins/sums must pass. Preserve all old evidence and source predictions.
inference: Descriptive only, no new pvalues/bootstrap, no subgroup best-policy selection or accuracy improvement claim. R35 sixty exploratory comparisons archived unchanged. No automatic recommendation to exclude/weight a state based on observed outcomes.
limits: All272historical outcomes previously viewed; this diagnostic is motivated by R35 errors. Coarse trend/vol labels are observables, not true latent market-state discovery. Future outcomes cannot validate weights on the same history. Fixed annual network and transforms retain allannualtraining information, including removedmembers. Group support counts are overlapping labels and sparse in2026, not effective sample size. Conditional label change can reflect omitted covariates; associations with addition effects do not isolate training subgroup causality. No new training/strategy, live action or replacement of annual baseline; old R25recent73/125=58.4% retained.
